content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To bake soft cookies, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Soften the butter at room temperature (1 hour)
Step 2. Cream the butter and sugar together (5 minutes)
Step 3. Whisk the dry ingredients thoroughly (2 minutes)
Step 4. Let the baked cookies set on the pan (5 minutes)
Step 5. Portion the dough onto baking sheets (10 minutes)
Step 6. Take the eggs out of the refrigerator (30 seconds)
Step 7. Add vanilla extract to the wet mixture (30 seconds)
Step 8. Crack the eggs into a small bowl (1 minute)
Step 9. Beat the eggs into the butter mixture (3 minutes)
Step 10. Mix in the molasses for extra softness (2 minutes)
Step 11. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees (15 minutes)
Step 12. Sift the flour to remove lumps (4 minutes)
Step 13. Measure out the baking soda (1 minute)
Step 14. Transfer cookies to a wire cooling rack (2 minutes)
Step 15. Fold in the chocolate chips by hand (3 minutes)
Step 16. Calibrate the kitchen scale (2 minutes)
Step 17. Locate the brown sugar in the pantry (1 minute)
Step 18. Find the cookie scoop (1 minute)
Step 19. Organize the workstation (10 minutes)
Step 20. Read the recipe card (5 minutes)
Step 21. Measure the all-purpose flour (3 minutes)
Step 22. Check the pantry for ingredients (10 minutes)
Step 23. Prepare the baking sheets with parchment (2 minutes)
Step 24. Clean the baking sheets (5 minutes)
Step 25. Soften the cream cheese for the secret ingredient (30 minutes)
Step 26. Wash the mixing bowls (5 minutes)
Step 27. Set out all measuring spoons (2 minutes)
Step 28. Combine salt and cinnamon (1 minute)
Step 29. Measure the granulated sugar (2 minutes)
Step 30. Scrape down the sides of the bowl (1 minute)
Step 31. Set the oven rack to the middle position (30 seconds)
Step 32. Buy a new bag of flour (45 minutes)
Step 33. Clear space on the counter (5 minutes)
Step 34. Prepare the cooling rack area (2 minutes)
Step 35. Mix the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients (4 minutes)
Step 36. Grease the edges of the pans (2 minutes)
Step 37. Add the white sugar to the bowl (1 minute)
Step 38. Dry the mixing bowls (1 minute)
Step 39. Place the pans in the oven to bake (12 minutes)
Step 40. Quality check the final dough consistency (1 minute)
